stop: Stop after the trimmed nuisance grid (pair + square x {v2, v2+clamp} at delta 0.08, v2 delta sweep): it decides whether the rho_dec ambiguity after v2 reaches the 5 percent probing threshold and whether a clamp ramp cuts it by 30 percent (docs/board/nuisance.md).
_doc: Trimmed resubmit of cfcap-nuis2.nuis-main (cancelled at ~3x the estimate). Same task, seeds and episode blocks (nseed 1909, 8 episodes per unit), so units match nuis2 ids. Scope: pair 64 / square 48 episodes x {v2, v2+clamp} at delta 0.08, plus v2 at delta 0.02/0.04/0.12/0.16 on pair 32 / square 24 (0.08 is the main grid). Excludes the 7 in-scope units of the still-leased cfcap-nuis2.nuis-main.s000 (listed in --exclude-units). 49 units over 7 shards. unit_s 780 s = the measured nuis-main rate (~13 min/unit, coordinator, from the nuis2 boxes).
